attributes.action: Make it so the police are not performance lead and improve managing workloads
attributes.additional_details: The Police should not be statistically driven. KPIs should be abolished and police officer should not be held accountable for how many arrests/stop searches etc they get over a period of time. The police should not be held accountable to response times. These should be removed as many people are driving quicker and putting more at risk to attend incidents within the required time. Officers in frontline departments should not be holding onto investigations. This should fall to dedicated teams.
attributes.background: Abolish Police KPIs, Stop having “incident response times” on Grade 1 and 2 incidents, Stop officers in Response, neighbourhood and proactive teams from holding investigations and have dedicated investigation teams to stop the workload issue in frontline policing

rejection.details:
We are not clear about the action you are seeking from the UK Government or Parliament, as some of the areas of this petition are devolved to individual police forces.

If you would like to, you could consider resubmitting a petition focused on the Police Performance Framework, and what action you would like the UK Government or Parliament to take in relation to it:
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/police-performance-framework
